description: I'm finishing the attic of my two-storey house as a bedroom and office. The only way out of the attic is down to the second floor and then down the main stair to the front door. The attic windows are small skylights. I don't want to add a dormer. What are my options?
known_facts: two storeys of travel to the exit door

missing_info.field: clear openable skylight height and width, sill height above floor and ground, and opening operation
missing_info.why: The window exception is dimensional; small skylights is not a measurement.

missing_info.field: whether there is direct balcony access and whether another suite is above or below
missing_info.why: The window and balcony alternatives must be checked before alleging excess travel.
Section A of the variance form

should_cite.why: Candidate benchmark only; deciding facts must be obtained first.
window alternative for units not above or below another suite
Candidate balcony alternative; direct access has not been described.
